geography: Worldwide (Allergan, Inc. product net sales, total column)
formulation: topical solution (applied to the upper eyelid margin)
moa: Prostaglandin F2-alpha analog (prostamide) promoting eyelash growth

approval_evidence.quote: 12/24/2008 ORIG-1 Approval Type 5 - New Formulation or New Manufacturer PRIORITY (NDA 022369, LATISSE BIMATOPROST)

launch_evidence.quote: Latisse ™ , our treatment for inadequate or insufficient eyelashes, which we launched in the United States in January 2009

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (January 2009); the Q1 2009 release is the first with a Latisse row (prior-year column '—').
series_end_reason: Allergan, Inc. was acquired by Actavis plc (renamed Allergan plc) on March 17, 2015; its last release is for 2014Q4 (filed 2015-02-04). Allergan plc printed no Latisse row in its 2015 releases; its first Latisse figures are U.S. Specialized Therapeutics segment figures only (a recast 8-K filed 2016-10-06, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000119312516732764/d261256dex991.htm, 'Latisse 2.7 22.9 13.8 23.8 19.8 17.7' for 2015Q1-2016Q2, and the Q2-Q3 2016 releases), and a worldwide Total (U.S. plus International) only from the Q4 2016 release. 2015Q1 is a post-close stub (2.7), so a worldwide series cannot be continued without changing scope or leaving a gap of more than one quarter; the series ends at Allergan, Inc.'s last quarter.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 850693 (Allergan, Inc.), CIK 1578845 (Actavis/Allergan plc) and CIK 1551152 (AbbVie) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages; fetched every earnings 8-K exhibit (items 2.02/12/9/7.01 or none) and 10-Q/10-K primary document for Allergan, Inc. 2007-07 to 2015-03 and Allergan plc 2014-07 to 2020-06.
Each quarter is the first 'Latisse' row (three months) of the product net sales table in the release reporting it as current; Q4 releases print a second Latisse row for the full year.
Each row checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing.
